label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Que príncipe pecare, e hiciere una desde todos mandamientos de Jehová su Dios que no se harán, por error, y culpado:
spanish: Que príncipe pecare, e hiciere una de todos los mandamientos de Jehová su Dios que no se harán, por error, y fuere culpable:
grammarChanges: Replaced bare passive participle 'culpado' with finite 'fuere culpable' (future subjunctive of ser) to restore the qal verb's 3ms person and verbal force on h03004022014.
Replaced 'desde todos' with 'de todos' on h03004022006 to render the partitive sense (one of all) instead of a starting point.
Added the article 'los' before 'mandamientos' because Spanish 'todos' requires 'todos los + noun'.
readerNote: Chose 'fuere culpable' (future subjunctive) over 'será culpable' to keep sequence-of-tense agreement with 'pecare'/'hiciere' while restoring the verb's person and force.
